args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece (https://insights.ironbark.example/warehouse/companion):

• Pick rates rose 18% in 2026 with the adoption of autonomous carts.
• Integration took twice as long as planned, a key operational caveat.
• The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.
args.title: Ironbark Warehouse Automation 2026 — Combined Summary
